requirement:
The harness MUST construct each assessment's mandatory input set by combining
the contributions specified by the requirements applicable to that subject and
its inputs. A requirement that contributes inputs MUST cite this requirement and
define which sources it contributes and when. The harness MUST include every
applicable contribution, deduplicate identical selections, and report
unresolvable mandatory inputs before inference. The complete set MUST be supplied
in the initial model request.
rationale: Pending implementation and verification of this evidence-authoring requirement. Any captured documentation inputs cover its example citations; they do not demonstrate implementation.

When `habeas author-evidence` assesses a subject with existing evidence, the
current resolution of each existing input selector MUST contribute to the
mandatory input set defined by {cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`.
The contribution MUST use the current source text selected by that input, rather
than its old recorded text. Reading these selectors MUST NOT modify the existing
evidence. The previous determination and rationale MUST NOT be supplied as
source evidence.
:::{req} authoring_inputs
When authoring evidence, every requirement or example directly referenced by the
assessed subject MUST contribute its complete fenced declaration to the
mandatory input set defined by {cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`.
Every source containing a valid implementation, citation, or test reference to
the assessed subject MUST also contribute to that set. For a reference in a Rust
item, the contribution MUST include the complete smallest enclosing item with
its attached comments and attributes. For a reference in a Markdown requirement,
example, or terminology declaration, it MUST include that complete declaration.
For other references, it MUST include the complete containing source file.
Literal references, evidence copies, and generated output MUST remain excluded
under the existing reference-discovery rules.
These contribution rules MUST apply to references directly from or to the
assessed subject. Including another declaration MUST NOT by itself recursively
expand that declaration's incoming or outgoing requirement and example references.
Citation links MUST NOT be described as proof that all substantively relevant
sources have been found.
:::{req} authoring_inputs
When authoring evidence for a named example, its complete fenced declaration
MUST be included in the mandatory input set defined by
{cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`.
:::{req} authoring_inputs
When preparing the mandatory input set defined by
{cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`, every terminology definition
referenced by the subject or any contributed source MUST contribute its complete
fenced declaration, including its phrase option. Definitions referenced by those
definitions MUST also be included transitively, without duplicates or
nontermination on cycles.
When an additional source read introduces a terminology dependency, the same
complete, transitive definition set MUST be supplied to the model and recorded
before accepting a submission.
